findings.detail: The claimed frozen data path is hard-coded to developer-specific absolute /home/wlia0047/... paths. From this workspace (/fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec), the real trainer cannot load either input at its entry point unless that external home path happens to exist. Thus the trainer entry point is not portable/runnable from the checked-out tree; export indexing logic itself does preserve row i -> item_id i (lines 1538-1559).
findings.reproduction: Run python train_rqvae.py in this checkout on a host without /home/wlia0047/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec; load_embeddings(EMBEDDING_FILE) fails with FileNotFoundError before training. The configured paths are not relative to the repository being reviewed.
findings.correction: Resolve the frozen Stage1 embedding and Stage0 parquet paths relative to the repository root (or validate/accept explicit configured paths) while keeping the exact frozen source files; rerun the real entry point and verify generated SID row count and item-id mapping.
